story: DARPA now has AI-controlled F-16s working as a team in virtual dogfights
text: > What puzzles me is that as of yet, there doesn't seem to be any talk of using "AI" (ie Neural Net stuff) for planning and strategy, which seems like a MUCH more powerful application than this stuff.
